references.text: The Lord emphasizes the importance of human life over religious rituals, which is also reflected in how Jesus argues for doing good on the Sabbath
Jesus refers to God's desire for mercy rather than sacrifice, highlighting acts of kindness over ritual observance
Jesus again defends doing good on the Sabbath by pointing out people's willingness to help their own animals, paralleling the argument about human value over that of animals
Similar to the reasoning in Matthew 12:12, where Jesus justifies healing on the Sabbath by comparing it to rescuing an animal
